out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device Used to Check Sanitizer Conc
violations.observation: The operator is not testing the chemical sanitizing solution to ensure proper concentration of the solution. PIC did not know how to properly use test kit.
violations.corrective_action: The operator shall be monitoring the concentration of the sanitizing solution using a test kit or other device. CDI EHS educated proper test kit use.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink in the kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CDI supplied towels

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch:pink McFlurry spindles observed with dark residue inside attachment.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. CDI cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Cooking Raw Animal Foods, Minimum of 155F
violations.observation: The following comminuted or ground meat, fish, or game animal was not cooked to a sufficient temperature and/or time to eliminate pathogenic bacteria: beef patty cooked to 148f on grill
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods such as ratites, injected meats, comminuted meats, commercially raised game animals, and raw eggs not for immediate consumption shall be cooked to a minimum internal temperature of 155F for at least 15 seconds. CDI cooked to 189f

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: overhead cooler by drive through at 45f, milk at 48f
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI milk discarded

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. Sanitizer solution measure 0ppm in sanitizer buckets being used.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. CDI sanitizer replaced to 100ppm cl

violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. MCDONALD'S RESTAURANT #6513 (Inspection Date: 05/12/2026) Page 2 of 3
